svg.title: Operation sequencing follows dependencies
svg.desc: Establish reference faces and edges. Locate and make features while supported. Separate small parts if needed. Finish after cutting, then inspect. Preserve holding material throughout.

g.text: Give later dimensions a reliable starting point.
Keep the work supported and accessible.
3. Separate small parts, if the route needs it
Retain the references used to locate features.
Check that finishing kept the required dimensions.
Inspect at checkpoints before defects are hidden.
Adapt the route to access, holding and the required result.
